title: asg-platform-polisher I/O contract
x-envelope-skill-enum-todo: asg-platform-polisher must be added to schemas/envelope.schema.json properties.skill.enum by the integrator

platform.description: Target platform whose conventions this pass enforces.

content.description: Upstream platform draft/script to polish (from facebook-page / facebook-groups / short-video-scripter, or a twitter/linkedin draft).

link.description: Canonical article URL to place per platform rule.

source_library_refs.description: Library IDs already present in the source article; polisher may only reuse from this set, never add new.

content.description: Final per-platform polished copy; length governed by publishing-gate §A 适配分发 row + platform norms.

char_count.description: Final content length after platform-length adaptation.

changes.description: Polish actions applied, e.g. length-trimmed, tone-recalibrated, hashtags-added, link-moved-first-comment, locale-fixed.

library_refs.description: Subset of input.source_library_refs actually carried into the polished copy. Never a superset.
